template.title: The Wiggling Toy and the Kind Heart
template.summary: A child shares a toy that falls into water, helping it and sharing a snack, and the story ends with a gentle, happy moment.

[[slot_child]] felt sad, but then thought of [[slot_pet]].

They sat on a blanket and watched the clouds.
[[slot_child]] imagined the toy dancing like a [[slot_sound]].
The toy's wiggle turned into a gentle rhythm.
When the sun set, they waved goodbye to the toy.

The [[slot_place]] felt brighter with the toy's happy wiggle.
And they all lived happily, playing and sharing.
